limits: The base encounter index retains classification evidence, not complete witnesses, episode narratives or bibliographies. Index missingness is not asserted to be source missingness.
All 10,853 Rosales accounts are parsed source accounts; their quantities cannot be added to the native encounter rows or interpreted as independently corroborated incidents.
Original capture and block hashes establish retrieval/provenance, not historical truth or source independence.
Clock-like raw strings are availability signals only. Runtime clock-supported UTC envelopes are separated from whole-calendar-day envelopes and verified UTC is not asserted.
Summary coordinate availability is kept separate from reviewed source-verified sites; neither city centroids nor source-provided points are independently validated by this audit.
Source witness counts, photographic/physical evidence custody, hypnosis status and exact entity traits are not guessed where the source has not received a manual episode-level review.
Research queue ordering balances source and issue strata, rather than ranking plausibility or evidential credibility.
